title: OFSCP WebSocket Message Envelope (v0.1)
description: Base envelope shared by every WebSocket message (§7.1). Direction-specific rules live in command-envelope.json (client→server: `data` an object; `ts` optional and ignored) and event-envelope.json (server→client: `ts` required). `ping` and `pong`, which either party may send, use this base envelope; when the provider sends one it MUST include `ts`.

id.description: Unique message identifier within a WebSocket connection. For client commands this is client-generated; for server events this is server-generated.

ts.description: RFC 3339 timestamp. Required on server→client events (event-envelope.json); optional on client→server commands, where providers ignore its value (command-envelope.json).

correlationId.description: Optional correlation identifier. For request/response interactions, providers SHOULD echo the client command `id` here.

data.description: Message payload. Schema is determined by `type`.
